name: Nuzlocke & Soul Link
description: The Nuzlocke and Soul Link rules for every Pokemon game: Red/Blue/Yellow, Gold/Silver/Crystal, Emerald/FireRed/LeafGreen, Platinum, HeartGold/SoulSilver and Black/White. A save opts in at NEW GAME (RUN MODES); every other save is untouched. Only the first POKéMON met in each area may be caught, a fainted POKéMON is gone for good (kept in the run's record, never deleted), and the run ends when the whole party is gone. Soul Link pairs your encounters with a friend's over an online world: when one dies, its partner dies too. Read the record from OPTIONS -> NUZLOCKE. (The randomizer is a game setting, not part of this mod.)
